gloss: to stretch in a row; to stand in a line; to attend

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {連|つら}なっていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to stretch in a row; to extend in a line
definitions.explanation: Describes things arranged or extending continuously in a line or series, such as mountains, buildings, or objects.

definitions.gloss: to attend; to take part in
definitions.explanation: To participate in a formal event or gathering, often as a member or attendee. More formal than 参加する.

notes:
{連|つら}なる is an intransitive godan verb. The transitive counterpart is ⟦{連|つら}ねる→連ねる：02080_tsuraneru⟧ (to line up, to take along).

ASPECT (ている):
{連|つら}なって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ describes a continuous state of being lined up or extending in a row. This is the most common form.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{連|つら}なる (something stretches in a row)
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{連|つら}なる (to attend/join something)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{連|つら}なる (mountains stretch in a row)
- ⟦{山脈|さんみゃく}→山脈：07856_sanmyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{連|つら}なる (a mountain range extends)
- ⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{連|つら}なる (to attend a gathering)
- ⟦{名|な}→名：03496_na⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{連|つら}ねる→連ねる：02080_tsuraneru⟧ (to have one's name listed — transitive form)
